before: Both MP4 parsers treat mdhd all-ones unknown duration as a numeric value. A three-frame owned VP9 file at timescale 50 reports 4294967295 ticks rather than 3; native duration reports roughly 994 days instead of 60ms. Three original parser/playback tests fail before the fix; known-duration companions pass their preceding assertions.
after: Recognize the version-width unknown mdhd marker, derive duration from the validated last indexed sample, and let fragment indexing extend it. Preserve explicitly known durations. V0/V1 regular and fragmented witnesses keep all exact packet bytes and 60ms probe/native duration. Core: 3 focused plus 4 related pass. Player: 4 focused plus 12 related pass, including exact RGB, eight seeks per movie, rewind and repeated EOF. Zero failures/ignored tests.

reference.meaning: All ones in mdhd duration indicate an unknown duration.

fixture_regeneration: Seven fixture hashes match independent generation without FFmpeg/network.
limits: This qualifies mdhd track duration recovery; unknown mvhd chapter bounds are not claimed. No performance, GUI, hardware or RSS claim.
